task_description: Make EVERY Gmail email tagged with a '<Name> lead' label reliably appear in the CRM as a lead attributed to and landing in that salesperson's Leads section, automatically — not just a few, and not dependent on an admin opening the inbox tab. Approach: add a server-side scheduled sync (Supabase edge function gmail-tag-sync + pg_cron) that covers the FULL mailbox by enumerating all label-tagged threads via a new Gmail Apps Script search action and the gmail-bridge proxy; unify the dedup key logic (real customer email + relay sender, lowercased) shared with the client; surface unmatched owner tags instead of dropping them; and reconcile the existing client-side auto-sync so it no longer creates duplicates or silently skips. Preserve existing manual claim/assign behavior and existing dedup.
